_about: Content sourced from theranchlife.com and its booking engine (newbooking.azds.com, Synxis-backed) on 2 Sep 2026, at the client's request. Same shape as src/data.js. Every object carries a `source` URL. Anything the site did not state is `null` with a `_note`, or the string "UNVERIFIED". Rates are the live nightly base rate (USD, before service charge, fees and taxes) returned by the booking engine for the sample windows named in `_rateSample`; they are per person, single occupancy, and will move with season and availability. See docs/content/CONTENT-SOURCE.md for verbatim quotes.

_rateSample.malibu: Signature Program, Sat 3 Oct – Sat 10 Oct 2026, 1 adult, 1 room (7 nights: Saturday pre-night $1,275 + 6 nights at $1,550) — https://newbooking.azds.com/api/hotel/ranch-malibu/rates?from=10/03/2026&to=10/10/2026&adults=1&rooms=1
_rateSample.hudson: 3-Night Signature Program, Thu 8 Oct – Sun 11 Oct 2026, 1 adult, 1 room — https://newbooking.azds.com/api/hotel/ranch-hudson-valley/rates?from=10/08/2026&to=10/11/2026&adults=1&rooms=1

malibu.name: The Ranch Malibu

malibu.depositCopy: A credit card is required for booking, as a deposit of 25% of total will be charged upon booking. The balance will be charged 40 days prior to arrival. If booking within 40 days of arrival, the full amount, inclusive of tax and fees, will be charged.
malibu.cancelCopy: If you cancel outside 41 days from your stay, a 10% fee will apply. Within 40 days of your stay, all payments are non-refundable and non-cancellable.
